description: Historical price timeseries for a coin. Requests use the nearest 1, 7, 30, 90 or 365-day window (default 7), bounded by available data. Requires a paid plan (Starter or above) over MCP; this endpoint does not apply the rate-history per-plan day clamp.

days.description: Requested days, rounded to the nearest supported window: 1, 7, 30, 90 or 365 days (default 7). Requests above 365 use 365; available data may be shorter.

name: coin_history

lastUpdated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent refresh

title: Historical coin price chart
